detail.title: Anthropic's Q3 revenue hits $16.8B but growth slows ahead of planned November IPO
detail.description: Anthropic hit $16.8 billion in third-quarter revenue, a 45 percent gain that still falls far short of Q2's 140 percent surge. With a November IPO approaching, some investors now expect the company's valuation to drop below $1.5 trillion. Slowing growth and a tough market are cooling expectations for the AI boom's biggest Wall Street test yet.

detail.description:
DeepSeek 今天的服务故障持续了接近五个小时 (4h52m)

API 和 Chat 服务都收到了影响，定位问题用了 1 个小时，修复用了 3 个多小时。目测这个问题不小，蹲一个官方对问题原因的公告。
